title: Bishop Sets, Rook Takes
setup: Black's king on c6 has a rook right behind it on b7, and your rook already owns the seventh rank.
hint: Which piece can check on a diagonal that carries on through the king to the rook waiting behind it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bd5+}} is the skewer: the diagonal d5–c6–b7 holds the king and, behind it, the rook. Your rook on **e5** guards d5, so the check cannot be taken. After {{Kb6}}, {{Rxb7+}} wins the rook, since the bishop now covers b7 too.
